investment_details: Blue Bear Group Corp. offers investment access through Limited Partnership Units in BBG Holding I LP and BBG Holding II LP, as well as Preferred Shares in BBG Corp. itself. Open to both Canadian accredited investors and select international investors, including UAE and GCC-based family offices. Canadian investors may hold BBG Preferred Shares inside a TFSA (tax-free growth) or RRSP (tax-deferred growth); LP units are typically held outside registered accounts. Preferred shareholders receive eligible dividends, taxed more favourably than interest income. International investors may benefit from Canada's tax treaties. To invest: schedule a consultation call, complete KYC and accreditation documents through our onboarding platform, sign a subscription agreement, and fund your commitment. For specific investment minimums, distribution schedules, and available tranches, please contact us at investors@bluebeargroup.ca or +1 437 826 4847.

faqs.q: What is the minimum investment amount?
faqs.a: Our investment minimums vary by fund and unit structure. We'd be happy to walk you through current options during a complimentary consultation — please reach out to us at investors@bluebeargroup.ca or call +1 437 826 4847.

BBG Holding LP investors receive distributions through a tiered waterfall structure once a fund reaches stabilization. BBG Corp. Preferred shareholders receive eligible dividends. Distributions are paid directly to your registered account or bank account. For the specific distribution schedule and rates applicable to current opportunities, we invite you to book a consultation with our team.

faqs.q: Is my investment TFSA or RRSP eligible?
faqs.a: BBG Preferred Shares are eligible to be held inside a TFSA for tax-free growth, or an RRSP for tax-deferred growth. LP units are generally held outside registered accounts. We always recommend consulting your financial advisor to confirm eligibility for your specific account and situation.

Yes, Blue Bear Group Corp. welcomes international investors, including family offices in the UAE and wider GCC region. Canada has tax treaties with many countries that may reduce withholding tax on eligible dividends. We recommend consulting a qualified tax professional in your home country for personalised guidance.

faqs.q: How does the property acquisition process work?
faqs.a: BBG conducts thorough due diligence on every property — evaluating NOI, IRR, cash-on-cash returns, neighbourhood trends, vacancy rates, and rental demand, supported by independent third-party appraisals. We target multifamily opportunities in Canada's fastest-growing urban centres. Only properties meeting our underwriting screen are acquired, and investors receive regular updates on portfolio performance.

faqs.q: What makes BBG different from other real estate investments?
faqs.a: Blue Bear Group Corp. applies institutional-grade private equity discipline — a GP/LP fund structure with aligned economics — to Canadian multifamily real estate. We focus on tech-integrated, community-focused properties in Canada's strongest rental markets. Our fund structure provides income-oriented, passive exposure to Canadian real estate without landlord responsibilities.

By 2030, Blue Bear Group Corp. aims to be among Canada's fastest-growing multifamily real estate platforms, active in five of the country's fastest-growing cities. Our mission is to address Canada's housing needs by acquiring and developing sustainable, high-quality rental properties while delivering purpose-driven returns for our investors.

faqs.q: What properties does BBG currently hold?
faqs.a: Our portfolio spans two limited partnerships across Quebec and Alberta. BBG Holding I LP holds The 311 de la Grande-Côte I — a stabilized, operating 5-unit multifamily property in Saint-Eustache, Quebec, near the REM transit line to downtown Montreal. BBG Holding II LP is deploying capital into Alberta, including three new-construction projects in the Leduc and Edmonton area — Creekside Circle I (10 units), a second Creekside townhome phase (12 units), and the Pleasantview Fourplex in southwest Edmonton (8 units) — all targeted for 2026 completion. We continue to source new acquisitions across Canada's high-demand urban markets.

faqs.q: What is the current size of BBG's portfolio?
faqs.a: Blue Bear Group Corp. currently manages two limited partnerships — BBG Holding I LP and BBG Holding II LP — spanning four properties and 35 total units across Quebec and Alberta. BBG Holding I LP's Saint-Eustache property is stabilized and operating; BBG Holding II LP's Alberta properties are in pre-construction and due diligence. Contact investors@bluebeargroup.ca for the latest availability and terms.
